name: mail-triage

scripts.build: prisma generate && node scripts/migrate-on-deploy.mjs && next build
scripts.db:migrate: tsx scripts/db-target.ts --action="run prisma migrate dev" && prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: tsx scripts/db-target.ts --action="run prisma migrate deploy" && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: tsx scripts/db-target.ts --action="run the main seed" && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.demo:seed: tsx scripts/db-target.ts --action="seed 12 demo bills" && tsx prisma/demo-seed.ts
scripts.demo:purge: tsx scripts/db-target.ts --action="delete all demo data" && tsx prisma/demo-purge.ts

description: Mail triage and action tracking platform
